title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: CJ Donaldson (shoulder) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: CJ Donaldson (shoulder) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Donaldson wasn't able to practice in a full capacity on Wednesday as he continues to recover from a shoulder issue. He should play in Week 7, but fantasy managers shouldn't expect much production out of him even if he's fully cleared.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Alvin Kamara (back) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Alvin Kamara (back) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Kamara was limited by a back injury on Wednesday, but that has been common for him over the course of the season and shouldn't prevent him from playing in Week 7. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high expectations for him moving forward, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DeShon Elliott (knee) practices in full Wednesday
items.desc: DeShon Elliott (knee) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
items.impact: Pittsburgh has yet to officially activate Elliott, but he was able to practice in full again on Wednesday and seems to have a very good chance of playing in Week 7. The Steelers' secondary will see a nice boost in talent whenever he's back in the lineup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ben Skowronek (calf) absent from practice Wednesday
items.desc: Ben Skowronek (calf) was absent from practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran wideout wasn't able to practice on Wednesday thanks to a calf issue that he's still dealing with. He may very well be sidelined again in Week 7, which wouldn't have much of an impact for fantasy purposes.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Rico Dowdle (knee) limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: Rico Dowdle (knee) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran was limited on Wednesday as he continues to manage the nagging effects of a knee issue. He should be good to go for Week 7, however, and projects to continue to play second fiddle on Pittsburgh's offense behind Jaylen Warren moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jalen Ramsey (wrist) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jalen Ramsey (wrist) missed Pittsburgh's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Ramsey was sidelined for Pittsburgh's practice on Wednesday, which comes as no surprise, as they have made a habit of limiting his workload early on in the practice weeks. He should play in Week 7, but that won't be official until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Christian Kirk (calf) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Christian Kirk (calf) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
items.impact: Kirk was able to log a full practice session on Wednesday, which bodes very well for his availability for Week 7. If active, he will see more work than usual in the event that Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) and Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) are ruled out against the Falcons.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) absent from practice Wednesday
items.desc: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) was absent from San Francisco's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: To no surprise, Samuel wasn't able to practice on Wednesday. He missed last week's game because of his hamstring issue, and he is expected to miss more time beyond that for the same reason. Christian Kirk (calf) may be one of the primary beneficiaries of his absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) did not take part in San Francisco's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: As expected, Evans was sidelined at practice on Wednesday. He's still dealing with a lingering groin injury and also aggravated an Achilles issue last week. It looks likely that he will be sidelined this week, especially with San Francisco's bye week right around the corner in Week 8.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Nick Bosa (knee/calf) sidelined at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Nick Bosa (knee/calf) was sidelined at San Francisco's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Bosa wasn't able to play for a fourth-straight game last week while he continues to recover from a pair of injuries. It seems more likely than not that he will be sidelined this week given that San Francisco has their bye week coming up in Week 8.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jermaine Eluemunor (calf) absent from practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jermaine Eluemunor (calf) was absent from New York's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Eluemunor missed last week's game due to a calf injury, and he wasn't able to practice on Wednesday for the same reason. It looks like the Giants may be down their starting offensive lineman again this week, which would be less than ideal ahead of a tough matchup against Houston's strong defense.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Charlie Jones (Achilles) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Charlie Jones (Achilles) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran wideout was limited due to an Achilles issue on Wednesday. He is relegated almost entirely to special teams at this point in the season, however, so his status doesn't carry much weight for fantasy purposes.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Theo Johnson (neck) limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: Theo Johnson (neck) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Johnson didn't play due to a neck issue last week, but he was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday and seems to be gearing up to play in Week 7. He won't be fantasy relevant even if active, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Andrew Thomas (groin) doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Andrew Thomas (groin) did not practice for the Giants on Wednesday.
items.impact: Thomas was held out of Wednesday's practice as part of the team's injury management for his groin issue. He should play in Week 7, assuming he suffers no setbacks at practice this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dylan Parham (knee) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: Dylan Parham (knee) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Parham has been sidelined for three-straight games while tending to a knee injury of some kind. He was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday, however, which indicates that he may be close to healthy enough to suit up. New York's offensive front will see a boost if that's the case.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Adonai Mitchell (finger) officially limited Wednesday
items.desc: Adonai Mitchell (finger) was officially limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Mitchell has been out for several games while nursing a finger injury, but it seems that he is finally returning to form, as he was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday. His return this week would be less than ideal for rookie Omar Cooper Jr., who showed signs of a breakout last week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Joseph Ossai (ankle) remains sidelined Wednesday
items.desc: Joseph Ossai (ankle) remained sidelined for New York's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Ossai wasn't able to practice on Wednesday, which doesn't come as much of a surprise. He is week-to-week right now and is a long-shot to suit up for the Jets in Week 7.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Will Kacmarek (hamstring) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Will Kacmarek (hamstring) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Kacmarek picked up a hamstring injury at some point and was limited at practice on Wednesday as a result. His potential absence this week wouldn't have much of an impact for fantasy purposes, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jaylen Wright (foot) considered limited Wednesday
items.desc: Jaylen Wright (foot) was considered limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Wright was considered limited on Wednesday due to a foot injury that he's managing. He should play through it in Week 7 but will remain the RB2 for Miami behind Ollie Gordon II for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Caleb Douglas (ankle) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Caleb Douglas (ankle) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The rookie seems to be doing much better after Miami's bye week. He was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday after missing several games with an ankle issue. His return would be good news for Miami's entire offense moving forward, though he isn't likely to have much individual fantasy value for the time being.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jordan Mason (thumb) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jordan Mason (thumb) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
items.impact: Mason seems to be trending the right direction for Week 7, as he was not limited in any way in his first official practice back on Wednesday. If he plays and has no workload restrictions this week, fantasy managers should consider starting him in a favorable matchup against the Colts.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Justin Jefferson (ankle) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Justin Jefferson (ankle) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The Vikings chose to limit Jefferson's workload at practice on Wednesday, though he is likely close to full health after the team's bye week last week. He should play and continue to be a good fantasy option in Week 7, barring something unforeseen.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: T.J. Hockenson (concussion) practices in full Wednesday
items.desc: T.J. Hockenson (concussion) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
items.impact: Hockenson was previously going through the NFL's concussion protocols, but he was able to practice in full on Wednesday and should be fully cleared to play in time for Sunday's game. He isn't likely to be much more than a streaming option on a week-to-week basis for the foreseeable future, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brian O'Neill (knee) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: Brian O'Neill (knee) was listed as a limited participant on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran is still listed on the injury report with a knee issue and was limited on Wednesday as a result. This has become a common occurrence for him over the course of the season, so the expectation is that he will continue to play through it again in Week 7.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Christian Darrisaw (concussion) a full participant Wednesday
items.desc: Christian Darrisaw (concussion) was a full participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Darrisaw was a full participant at Minnesota's practice on Wednesday, meaning that he should receive full clearance to play well before Sunday's game. His expected presence is great news for the Vikings ahead of a matchup against the Colts this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jordan Addison (hamstring) officially a full participant Wednesday
items.desc: Jordan Addison (hamstring) was officially a full participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Addison seems to be close to full health again after Minnesota's bye week last week. He was a full participant at practice on Wednesday and should be a full go for Week 7, although he doesn't project to be a strong fantasy option for the foreseeable future if Justin Jefferson (ankle) is in the lineup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mike Washington Jr. (foot/back) limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: Mike Washington Jr. (foot/back) was a limited participant on Wednesday.
items.impact: Washington was left limited at Wednesday's practice. He's dealing with a couple of different injuries right now, and it's unclear if they will leave him with an injury designation heading into the weekend. Dylan Laube would see more work in the off-chance that Washington is out this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dont'e Thornton Jr. (hamstring) practices in full Wednesday
items.desc: Dont'e Thornton Jr. (hamstring) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
items.impact: Thornton was able to practice in a full capacity on Wednesday, which is a good sign that he is trending towards making his season debut in Week 7. His return isn't likely to have much of an impact for fantasy purposes, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kolton Miller (shoulder) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Kolton Miller (shoulder) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran wasn't able to log a full practice session on Wednesday, as he's currently dealing with a shoulder issue of some kind. It doesn't look likely to leave him sidelined in Week 7, but we won't know for sure until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brock Bowers (hamstring/calf) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Brock Bowers (hamstring/calf) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Bowers is dealing with two minor injuries right now. He's listed with a hamstring issue and a calf issue, which left him limited at Las Vegas' first practice of the week on Wednesday. Fantasy managers would be wise to keep tabs on his status throughout the rest of the week, although he doesn't seem to be at much risk of being sidelined on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dalton Schultz (quad) doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Dalton Schultz (quad) did not take part in Houston's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran tight end wasn't able to practice on Wednesday. He's recovering from a quad injury right now, and the team wants to be cautious with his recovery early on in the week. His participation at Thursday and Friday's practices should give us a lot more insight into whether or not he will suit up in Week 7.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Blake Fisher (thumb) a non-participant Wednesday
items.desc: Blake Fisher (thumb) was a non-participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran wasn't able to practice on Wednesday due to a thumb injury that he is currently battling. If it leaves him sidelined in Week 7, that would be bad news for a Houston offensive front that is already among the league's worst units.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Trent Brown (wrist) sidelined from practice Wednesday
items.desc: Trent Brown (wrist) was sidelined from Houston's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The big man was unable to practice on Wednesday, as he's dealing with some kind of a wrist injury at the moment. This won't be a problem unless he still carries an injury designation heading into the weekend.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: David Montgomery (groin) doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: David Montgomery (groin) did not take part in Houston's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Montgomery has missed some time while recovering from a groin issue, and he was also unable to practice for the Texans on Wednesday. If he's out for another week, fantasy managers should expect Woody Marks and Jawhar Jordan to continue to see more work in his extended absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Azeez Al-Shaair (groin) absent from practice Wednesday
items.desc: Azeez Al-Shaair (groin) was absent from Houston's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Al-Shaair was held out of Wednesday's practice as part of the injury management for his groin. Chances are that he will be available to play in Week 7, however, and he will continue to be one of Houston's top defenders if that's the case.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jonah Coleman (ankle) practices in full Wednesday
items.desc: Jonah Coleman (ankle) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
items.impact: The rookie was able to log a full practice session on Wednesday. He has missed several weeks due to an ankle injury, but it looks like he is over it at this point and will more than likely be active in Week 7. If that's the case, that will be bad news for the fantasy value of RJ Harvey moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jaylen Waddle (chest) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jaylen Waddle (chest) was limited at Denver's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Waddle is now dealing with some kind of a chest injury and was left limited at practice on Wednesday as a result. It doesn't seem to be a serious issue at this point, but fantasy managers should continue to monitor his practice participation throughout the week to see if he'll play in Week 7. He remains a debatable starter in most league formats even if fully healthy, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Pat Surtain II (ankle) officially limited Wednesday
items.desc: Pat Surtain II (ankle) was officially limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The Broncos have been without their star cornerback for a couple of weeks, but he was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday and will have a chance to play in Week 7. Denver's already-great defense will improve significantly whenever he's available to make his return to the lineup for them.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: C.J. Henderson (groin) considered limited Wednesday
items.desc: C.J. Henderson (groin) was considered limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Henderson missed last week's game due to a groin issue. He's still dealing with it, but he was at least able to practice in a limited capacity on Wednesday. Atlanta's secondary will be much stronger if he's back in the lineup this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Olamide Zaccheaus (shoulder) limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: Olamide Zaccheaus (shoulder) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran wasn't able to log a full practice on Wednesday, as he was left limited by a shoulder injury of some kind. Rookie Zachariah Branch may see more work if the veteran has to miss any time.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: A.J. Terrell Jr. (groin) officially limited Wednesday
items.desc: A.J. Terrell Jr. (groin) was officially limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Terrell was recently designated to return from injured reserve, so he came back to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday. It may be another week or two before he's fully ready to go, but his return will be a nice boost for the Falcons whenever it comes.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Robinson's hamstring is a new issue for him. He was still able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday, which indicates that it's not a very serious issue. It remains to be seen if it will cause him to be sidelined for a week or not.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Savion Williams (ankle) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Savion Williams (ankle) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Williams was unable to log a full practice on Wednesday, as he's still dealing with a nagging ankle issue. He was able to play through it last week, however, which suggests that he will do the same again this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Matthew Golden (shoulder) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Matthew Golden (shoulder) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: A shoulder issue left Golden limited at Green Bay's practice on Wednesday. It's not thought to be a serious issue at this point, so fantasy managers should tentatively plan on him playing as usual in Week 7, unless we hear a report to the contrary sometime in the next couple of days.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Bo Melton (back) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Bo Melton (back) missed Green Bay's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: A back injury left Melton sidelined at Green Bay's first practice of the week on Wednesday. It may leave him sidelined for Week 7 as well, which would possibly lead to more work for Savion Williams (ankle) this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Aaron Banks (knee/toe) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Aaron Banks (knee/toe) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Banks was again limited at practice on Wednesday as he continues to manage a pair of injuries. Green Bay's offensive front will be much better in Week 7 if he's fully healthy and available to play against the Lions.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jordan Love (back) officially limited Wednesday
items.desc: Jordan Love (back) was officially limited at Green Bay's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Love is now dealing with some kind of a back issue. It left him limited at practice on Wednesday, but it doesn't seem to be more than a minor issue for the veteran quarterback at this point. Fantasy managers should not be concerned about his availability unless he carries an injury designation heading into the weekend.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Christian Watson (ankle) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Christian Watson (ankle) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Watson is a new addition to the team's injury report, being listed with an ankle injury of some kind that left him limited at practice on Wednesday. It doesn't seem to be a serious issue, but fantasy managers should keep close tabs on all updates about his health throughout the week nonetheless.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Andrew Vorhees (foot) limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: Andrew Vorhees (foot) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Vorhees has been sidelined for two-straight practices due to a foot issue, but he was back at practice on Wednesday and seems to be trending towards playing in Week 7. His return would be good news for Baltimore's offensive front ahead of a matchup against the Cincinnati Bengals.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: John Simpson (groin) limited Wednesday
items.desc: John Simpson (groin) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran was limited by a groin issue on Wednesday. He has been able to play this issue recently, however, so fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to miss any time unless he suffers a setback with his recovery at some point.
